# Google Analytics ja YouTube'i sündmused

Kui soovid mõõta lehe külastusi ja YouTube videote kasutust, lisa projekti järgmised failid ja seadistus.

## Muuda `_quarto.yml` faili

Failis `Opikud/Book_Project/_quarto.yml` lisa HTML formaadi alla:

``` yaml
format:
    html:
        include-in-header:
            - analytics.html
        include-after-body:
            - youtube-ga4.html
```

## Loo `analytics.html`

Fail: `Opikud/Book_Project/analytics.html`

``` html
<!-- Google tag (gtag.js) -->
<script async src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-XXXXXXXXXX"></script>
<script>
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
    gtag('js', new Date());

    gtag('config', 'G-XXXXXXXXXX');
</script>
```

Asenda `G-XXXXXXXXXX` oma GA4 Measurement ID-ga.

## Loo `youtube-ga4.html`

Fail: `Opikud/Book_Project/youtube-ga4.html`

``` html
<script>
  // Load YouTube IFrame API
  var tag = document.createElement('script');
  tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
  document.head.appendChild(tag);

  var players = [];

  function onYouTubeIframeAPIReady() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.yt-video').forEach((iframe, i) => {
      players[i] = new YT.Player(iframe, {
        events: {
          'onStateChange': onPlayerStateChange
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function onPlayerStateChange(event) {
    if (event.data !== 2) return;

    gtag('event', 'youtube_pause', {
      video_id: event.target.getVideoData().video_id,
      video_title: event.target.getVideoData().title,
      page_path: location.pathname
    });
  }
</script>
```

## YouTube iframe nõue `.qmd` failides

YouTube iframe peab sisaldama:

1.  URL-is `?enablejsapi=1` (või `&enablejsapi=1`, kui URL-is on juba parameetrid)
2.  atribuuti `class="yt-video"`

Näide:

``` html
<iframe
    class="yt-video"
    width="560"
    height="315"
    src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/VIDEO_ID?enablejsapi=1"
    title="YouTube video player"
    frameborder="0"
    allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"
    referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    allowfullscreen>
</iframe>
```

Pärast muudatusi renderda raamat uuesti, et skriptid lisataks kõikidele lehtedele.
